title: Tajan Auction This Weekend
content: This weekend is the auction of comics and fantasy art at the Tajan auction house in Paris. There are three original Dinotopia paintings, the only Dinotopia originals that I’ll offer for sale this year, and the first ever from Journey to Chandara.------Galerie Daniel Maghenis the expert adviser in the sale. For more information, please email  Olivier Souille at "info@danielmaghen.com"See the range of work for sale atComic Art Fans.comor atTajan
